body.x: ILUMI (www.ilumi.co), a leading provider of intelligent, simple and innovative wirelessly controlled LED lightning solution, unveiled "Smartbulb" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.This simple, smart bulb requires no wi-fi to make connection. It is controlled by the free Ilumi app installed on the smartphone, so there is no complication. Its hyperlux LED technology enables the emission of more lumens per watt than any other multicolored light bulb in class, so the whites are brighter and colors are more saturated. It also comes with smart functions such as real-time clock and memory for a customized use.
Also, Smartbulb is budget-friendly and energy-efficient with its long lasting bulb of up to 20 years.
